configuration.title: Remote Collector
setting.codexNotifier.codexHome: Codex home in this environment. Empty uses CODEX_HOME, then ~/.codex.
setting.codexNotifier.pythonPath: Python executable without arguments. Defaults to python3 on Linux/macOS or py -3 on Windows.
setting.codexNotifier.sourceLabel: Server/container display label. Empty uses the connection type and hostname; each event carries its own project path.
setting.codexNotifier.collectorEnabled: Read Codex event metadata while this trusted workspace is open.
setting.codexNotifier.cacheRetentionDays: Collector notification-cache retention in this environment (1–30 days). Expiry runs during collection; original conversations are untouched.
